itens.t: North Korea fires salvo of around 10 ballistic missiles toward the sea
itens.r: North Korea has launched a salvo of approximately 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the eastern sea, according to the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff. The provocative launch comes amid heightened cross-border tensions and ongoing military maneuvers in the region. Seoul's military is closely monitoring the situation in coordination with international allies. Analysts view the missile volley as a direct display of force amid strained diplomatic ties.

itens.t: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
itens.r: A devastating Russian drone strike has killed at least 14 people at a crowded Ukrainian rail platform. Emergency services rushed to the scene to extinguish fires and rescue survivors from the debris. International leaders have condemned the attack on civilian infrastructure.

itens.t: US inflation heats up in September as consumer spending rises
itens.r: U.S. consumer prices increased in September while consumer spending rose solidly, pointing to persistent economic momentum. The data highlights ongoing challenges for the Federal Reserve as it weighs future interest rate decisions.

itens.t: N. Korea builds 'military leader' narrative around Kim Ju-ae, says spy agency
itens.r: South Korea's National Intelligence Service reported that Pyongyang is increasingly shaping a military leader narrative around Kim Jong-un's daughter, Ju-ae. Observers note this systematic promotion signals ongoing efforts to cement her status as his eventual successor.

itens.t: Microsoft AI study shows tool outperforming human general practitioners
itens.r: A landmark study published in Science demonstrates that a medical AI tool outperformed human general practitioners in resolving complex clinical cases. Researchers believe this breakthrough could eventually transform preliminary diagnostic workflows.

itens.t: Astronomers discover mysterious potential dwarf planet beyond Neptune
itens.r: The Vera Rubin Observatory has detected an icy celestial body designated 2026 ED138 lurking far beyond Neptune. Initial estimates suggest the distant object spans up to 1,500 kilometers across, potentially qualifying as a new dwarf planet.

itens.t: Samsung Lions edge out Kia Tigers in tense KBO postseason clash
itens.r: The Samsung Lions delivered key home runs to edge past the Kia Tigers in a dramatic postseason matchup. The narrow victory puts the Lions on the verge of claiming the series victory.

itens.t: Rocket Lab ships Neutron rocket's Stage 2 and Thrust Module
itens.r: This video showcases Rocket Lab transporting the Neutron rocket's Stage 2 and Thrust Module via truck and barge to Launch Complex 3 at Wallops Island.

itens.t: SpaceX fires up Starship upper stage ahead of Flight 15
itens.r: SpaceX has completed crucial static-fire tests on the Starship upper stage ahead of its upcoming 15th flight test. Engineers are preparing the vehicle for an ambitious launch profile from Texas.

itens.t: South Korea and Germany forge enhanced strategic partnership
itens.r: Seoul and Berlin have agreed to elevate bilateral ties to an enhanced strategic partnership amid mounting global security risks. The pact expands cooperation into advanced technologies, future growth sectors, and defense.

itens.t: DoorDash strikes $17 billion deal for US rival Instacart
itens.r: DoorDash has agreed to acquire U.S. rival Instacart for $17 billion in a massive grocery delivery consolidation bet. The blockbuster transaction reshapes the competitive landscape for online food and retail delivery.

itens.t: US sanctions 10 nationals over North Korean IT worker fraud
itens.r: Washington has imposed sanctions on 10 North Korean and Russian nationals involved in deceptive IT worker schemes. The illicit operations allegedly generated substantial revenue to fund Pyongyang's banned weapons programs.

itens.t: Nasdaq slides over 1% as Alphabet earnings revive AI spending fears
itens.r: The Nasdaq composite dropped more than one percent following Alphabet's latest financial report, which sparked renewed investor anxiety over heavy capital expenditure in artificial intelligence. Wall Street is increasingly scrutinizing whether the massive tech investments will yield near-term returns.

itens.t: Iran's hidden military network evades US blockade hardware
itens.r: Investigative reports reveal that a clandestine web of Iranian military agencies continues to slip essential hardware past U.S. naval blockades. The maritime routing relies on a series of front companies and obscured cargo transfers.

itens.t: Israeli strikes hit Gaza as Health Ministry urges Rafah opening
itens.r: Gaza's Health Ministry reported dozens of deaths among patients awaiting medical evacuation as Israeli military strikes continue. Authorities are urgently appealing for the reopening of the Rafah crossing to alleviate the humanitarian crisis.

itens.t: Netanyahu falls short of majority as Israeli elections deadlock
itens.r: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's governing coalition fell short of a parliamentary majority following a surge for Arab parties. The resulting political deadlock leaves the nation facing multiple potential paths to form a government.

itens.t: Mistral AI unveils Le Chonk model targeting open-weight race
itens.r: French AI lab Mistral has released a new open-weight model named Le Chonk, claiming it matches leading competitors in coding and cybersecurity performance. The release marks a fresh escalation in the global race for open-access artificial intelligence.

itens.t: Startup seeks to automate formal software verification with math
itens.r: A new startup called &Truth is attempting to automate formal verification using rigorous mathematics to prove software works flawlessly. The initiative aims to reduce critical bugs in enterprise applications.

itens.t: US military captures imagery of China's secretive space plane
itens.r: A high-resolution photograph released by U.S. commercial satellite operators has captured China's reusable Shenlong space plane docked in orbit. The rare image offers analysts a close-up look at Beijing's classified orbital capabilities.

itens.t: Brazilian stock exchange loses R$ 873 billion following election
itens.r: The Brazilian stock market experienced steep losses following the conclusion of the general election runoff, wiping out billions in market value. Investors reacted nervously to fiscal uncertainties and shifting political alignments.

itens.t: South Korean President and Saudi Crown Prince discuss Mideast crisis
itens.r: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held telephone talks to strengthen bilateral cooperation amid the ongoing Middle East conflict. Both leaders emphasized energy security and mutual economic support.

itens.t: ECB keeps interest rates unchanged but warns of inflation risks
itens.r: The European Central Bank left its key interest rates steady while signaling mounting risks from persistent inflation pressures. Policymakers stressed that borrowing costs will remain data-dependent in the coming months.

itens.t: Samsung SDS targets Asia's first Nvidia Vera Rubin cloud launch
itens.r: Samsung SDS announced plans to deploy Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin GPUs in its cloud infrastructure by March 2027. The move aims to cement its status as an early provider of high-end AI computing power in Asia.

itens.t: Taliban poppy ban falters as Afghan farmers face starvation
itens.r: Strict enforcement of the Taliban's opium poppy ban is faltering as impoverished Afghan farmers state they cannot feed their families otherwise. Agricultural communities are increasingly defying local edicts out of economic desperation.

itens.t: Hugo Calderano dominates Shinozuka to advance at WTT Montpellier
itens.r: Brazilian table tennis star Hugo Calderano secured a dominant straight-set victory over Japan's Hiroto Shinozuka at the WTT Champions event in Montpellier. With the win, Calderano comfortably advances to the tournament's round of 16.

itens.t: Eli Lilly raises revenue outlook on surging weight-loss drug demand
itens.r: Eli Lilly upgraded its full-year revenue forecast as robust sales of its popular weight-loss treatments offset minor misses elsewhere. Company shares rallied following the strong financial update.

itens.t: Fierce fighting near Yemen's Taiz displaces hundreds of thousands
itens.r: Intense clashes near the Yemeni city of Taiz have forced more than 281,000 people to flee their homes since August. United Nations agencies are urgently appealing for safe humanitarian access to assist the displaced population.

itens.t: SpaceX plans double catch attempt for Starship flight 15
itens.r: This video details SpaceX's plans to catch both the booster and the upper stage during the upcoming Flight 15 test, requiring the ship to fly over land.

itens.t: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train crash
itens.r: Spanish athlete Julieta Gallego, 24, has been identified among the 69 fatalities resulting from a catastrophic train collision in Spain. The sports community expressed profound grief over the tragic loss of the young jumper.

itens.t: President Lula seeks civilian woman to lead Defense Ministry
itens.r: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is reportedly searching for a civilian woman to head the Ministry of Defense. The historic appointment would mark the first time a female civilian leads the nation's Armed Forces.

itens.t: Bunge's net profit nearly doubles in third quarter of 2026
itens.r: Agribusiness giant Bunge reported a net profit of $318 million for the third quarter of 2026, nearly doubling its earnings from the previous year.

itens.t: Government to test 35% ethanol blend in gasoline starting January
itens.r: Brazil's Ministry of Mines and Energy plans to launch tests in January for a higher anhydrous ethanol blend in commercial gasoline.

itens.t: Court authorizes Marcola to undergo psychiatric evaluation
itens.r: Federal authorities have granted permission for incarcerated gang leader Marco Willians Herbas Camacho to consult with a private psychiatrist.

itens.t: STJ rejects Robinho's final appeal against nine-year prison sentence
itens.r: The Superior Court of Justice has denied a fresh legal challenge filed by former footballer Robinho regarding his nine-year sentence.

itens.t: DOJ launches 'Operation Ghostbusters' to crack down on student aid fraud
itens.r: Federal law enforcement agencies initiated a nationwide crackdown targeting an international student aid scam operating since 2021.

itens.t: Olympics tap former Lucasfilm chief Kathleen Kennedy for ceremonies
itens.r: Los Angeles 2028 organizers have appointed former Lucasfilm executive Kathleen Kennedy to spearhead the upcoming opening and closing ceremonies.

itens.t: QatarEnergy secures US LNG supplies to hedge against Hormuz risks
itens.r: QatarEnergy has purchased liquefied natural gas from the U.S. and other suppliers to protect against potential shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

itens.t: Pentagon investigates military base freezer malfunctions as cyberattack
itens.r: Defense officials confirmed the Pentagon is treating recent storage freezer malfunctions across multiple military bases as a suspected cyberattack.

itens.t: Russia sends fighter jets and air defense systems to Ethiopia
itens.r: Moscow is deploying military aircraft and defense assets to Ethiopia in a bid to expand its diplomatic influence and arms revenue in Africa.

itens.t: King Charles tours Caribbean as demands for slavery reparations grow
itens.r: Britain's King Charles joined cultural celebrations during a visit to the Bahamas ahead of a major Commonwealth summit.

itens.t: South Africa names Durban in bid to host 2036 or 2040 Olympics
itens.r: South African sports authorities announced Durban as their candidate city to bring the Olympic Games to the African continent.

itens.t: Virgin Galactic unveils its first Delta-class space plane, Apeiron
itens.r: Virgin Galactic publicly debuted its next-generation Delta-class vehicle, christened Apeiron following a global public vote.

itens.t: Vietnam joins Artemis Accords as newest space exploration signatory
itens.r: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam has signed the Artemis Accords, becoming the 78th nation committed to peaceful lunar exploration.

itens.t: Investigation links overseas North Korean workers to Russian military
itens.r: A new investigative report ties expatriate North Korean laborers to firms supporting Russia's military-industrial supply chain.

itens.t: South Korea expands defense cooperation with Singapore and Vietnam
itens.r: Seoul's defense ministry confirmed new bilateral agreements with Singapore and Vietnam to deepen regional military collaboration.

itens.t: Multicultural families in South Korea face online political scrutiny
itens.r: Marriage migrants in South Korea have expressed concern over recent political remarks regarding state benefits for multicultural households.

itens.t: Seoul and Washington advance wartime operational control discussions
itens.r: South Korean security officials report steady progress in talks with the U.S. regarding the eventual transfer of wartime operational control.

itens.t: Former Palmeiras winger Riquelme Filipi rescues Inter Miami with late goal
itens.r: Young Brazilian forward Riquelme Filipi scored a dramatic late equalizer to salvage a draw for Inter Miami against Cincinnati.

itens.t: Lucas Halter secures historic MLS victory for Houston Dynamo
itens.r: Defender Lucas Halter netted the decisive header to give the Houston Dynamo a crucial away win over the Seattle Sounders.

itens.t: Itapema prepares to host international beach volleyball championship
itens.r: The coastal city of Itapema in Santa Catarina will welcome 64 pairs for a major World Beach Volleyball Tour event in December.

itens.t: Abrasca warns of risk of increased tax burden for companies
itens.r: The tax burden on Brazilian companies tends to increase if two fiscal proposals are implemented, according to a statement by Abrasca.

itens.t: 13-year-old boy swam 4 km in rough sea, ran on the beach and called rescue to save family
itens.r: A 13-year-old teenager swam about 4 kilometers in open sea, walked another 2 kilometers on the sand, and called the emergency service to save his mother and two younger siblings.

itens.t: Behind the scenes: Bap admits mistakes and warns he will change Flamengo's market stance
itens.r: During a meeting that recalculated Flamengo's financial situation for 2026, Bap admitted mistakes and announced a shift in the club's transfer market approach.

itens.t: Oeirense signs midfielder Aurélio, formerly of Picos and 4 de Julho, for 2027 season
itens.r: Oeirense announced the signing of midfielder Aurélio for the 2027 season. The player returns to the club after previous stints elsewhere.

itens.t: Survivor of Mao's cultural revolution speaks out on Kylian Mbappe fallout in China over meme
itens.r: Soccer star Kylian Mbappe laughing at a meme of dictator Mao Zedong has sparked backlash and TV blackouts in China, drawing comments from a cultural revolution survivor.

itens.t: Robust consumer spending, AI-related investment power US economy in third quarter - Reuters
itens.r: Strong consumer spending and investments in artificial intelligence drove the growth of the US economy during the third quarter.

itens.t: US First Lady praised for Oleshky relief truce as Moscow strikes Ukrainian commuters - Reuters
itens.r: The US First Lady received praise for a relief truce in Oleshky, even as Moscow carried out strikes against Ukrainian commuters.

itens.t: US First Lady praised for Oleshky relief truce as Moscow strikes Ukrainian commuters - Reuters
itens.r: The US First Lady was praised for securing a relief truce in Oleshky while Moscow launched strikes hitting Ukrainian commuters.

itens.t: Mistral AI publicly releases Large 4, targets cybersecurity users - Reuters
itens.r: Mistral AI has officially released its Large 4 model, aiming specifically to cater to cybersecurity professionals and users.

itens.t: Israel’s anti-Qatar campaign bleeds into elections
itens.r: Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesman rejected disinformation following allegations of voting interference made by certain Israeli figures.

itens.t: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train collision
itens.r: Julieta Gallego, an athlete who competed for Madrid-based AD Sprint, was among those killed in a tragic train crash in Spain.

itens.t: The universe in the eye of a telescope | Space photo of the day for Oct. 29, 2026
itens.r: The Swedish-ESO Submillimetre Telescope captures starlight reflections at the La Silla Observatory in Chile.

itens.t: Envía tu nombre a Titán a bordo de la misión Dragonfly de la NASA
itens.r: La campaña Viaje a Titán permite al público enviar sus nombres en un microchip a bordo de la misión Dragonfly para explorar la luna de Saturno.

itens.t: Send Your Name to Titan Aboard NASA’s Dragonfly Mission
itens.r: NASA's Journey to Titan campaign gives the public a chance to send their names on a microchip aboard the upcoming Dragonfly rotorcraft mission.

itens.t: North Korea Continues Installing New Fencing
itens.r: North Korea is proceeding with the installation of new security fencing along its borders.

itens.t: How War Memorialization Legitimizes the Russia-DPRK Alliance and Strengthens Kim Jong Un’s Legitimacy
itens.r: An analysis of how war memorials are utilized to reinforce the political alliance between Russia and North Korea and boost leadership legitimacy.

itens.t: Chinese agency claims it’s organizing youth tours to North Korea’s Wonsan resort
itens.r: A Chinese travel agency asserts it has been invited to run youth trips to North Korea's Wonsan Kalma beach resort, though doubts remain.

itens.t: Border city casts doubt on reports North Korea testing loudspeakers
itens.r: A South Korean border city questioned reports regarding North Korea testing anti-South loudspeakers following resident testimonies.

itens.t: Spy chief upholds Seoul's controversial repatriation of North Korean fishermen
itens.r: National Intelligence Service Director Lee Jong-seok defended the repatriation of two North Korean fishermen accused of murdering crew members.

itens.t: Lions manager gives kudos to bullpen after narrow KBO postseason win
itens.r: The Lions manager praised the team's bullpen performance following a hard-fought postseason victory in the KBO.

itens.t: (LEAD) Dream postseason continues for Lions outfielder with clutch hit
itens.r: A Samsung Lions outfielder kept his stellar postseason run alive with a crucial clutch hit during Thursday's game.

itens.t: NASA Wasn't Tracking 22 Starship Refueling Flights. Elon Says 6 to 8 🚀
itens.r: During an Artemis press conference, NASA managers discussed the discrepancy in estimated Starship refueling flights compared to Elon Musk's projections.
